timezone_policy: Use the device current timezone for delivery and preserve event-local/logical-day identity for source facts.
default_migration: Preserve existing settings. All newly introduced push families remain off until selected.

explicit_reminders.authorization: User selects the category, time, recurrence, and expected count.
explicit_reminders.budget: Keep the chosen schedule. Proactive budget does not cancel explicit reminders.
explicit_reminders.quiet_exception: Applies only to the selected reminder at its selected time.

state.pending_overflow_policy: Preserve accepted selected schedules; prefer generic recurring requests, bound one-shot horizon, and surface any actual scheduling failure.
state.unknown_outcome_without_platform_record: submission_uncertain; retain attention charge; do not resubmit proactive occurrence

scheduling.expiry_scope: latest useful app evaluation or submission; not a guaranteed OS presentation cutoff
scheduling.future_scheduled_copy: generic unless its claims remain valid through the selected occurrence
scheduling.cancellation: when changed state is committed or observed at an available execution opportunity
scheduling.one_shot_dst_missing_minute: first valid local time after the gap
scheduling.repeating_calendar_dst: platform matching; verify on device and reconcile on lifecycle opportunities
